content:
Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

![76 ATX santatron SM 500x281](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/ZRcdSuMcutSgcxweihmP2/c56b7070a818b05e0f1149b307bf0c37/76_ATX_santatron_SM_500x281.gif)

![76 Pirate Ship 1920 870](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/2MgyoVSOA3qOCMWdcVthjG/b015c78a6b94cfe4546fc559bd252059/76_Pirate_Ship_1920_870.png)

Kwanzaa is just around the corner! What better way to celebrate than with a free Happy Kwanzaa poster? For all Fallout 76 players through **3. January** free.

Be careful, the Santatron slides into your C.A.M.P. Get the Santatron Collectron Station for free from the Atomic Shop until January 3rd. When you're out on winter adventures, the Santatron will collect delicious sweets for you - or coal if you haven't been quite so good throughout the year. The Santatron will even be looking for gifts for you during the Festive Burnt event starting December 20th.

Additionally, Fallout 1st members have until **3. January** get the pirate ship set for free.

| **Item** | **Available until** | 
| Happy Kwanzaa Poster | January 3rd | 
| Santatron Collectron Station | January 3rd | 
| Pirate Ship Set **(Fallout 1st)** | January 3rd | 

Grab something free in the Atomic Shop this week too. Each of the items is always available until **18:00 CET** the following day.

| **Item** | **Available on** | 
| Skill Card Pack | December 27th | 
| Lunchbox | December 28th | 
| Repair kit | December 29th | 
| Tail fireworks | December 30 | 
| Nuclear Missile Key Card | December 31st | 
| Repair kit | January 1st | 
| Legendary Ticket x 50 | January 2nd | 

## WEEKLY OFFERS

This week the Atomic Shop has offers again! Each item is always available until **18:00 CET** of the specified day.

| **Item** | **Atoms** | **Available from** | **Available until** | 
| Power Armor Paint (Alien Invader) **(Fallout 1st)** | ~~1,200~~ 1,080 (-10%) | December 27th | January 3rd | 
| Power Armor Wrap (Skulllord) **(Fallout 1st)** | ~~1,400~~ 1,260 (-10%) | December 27th | January 3rd | 
| Power Armor Rack Pack | ~~1,200~~ 1,080 (-10%) | December 27th | January 3rd |
